evidence.detail: active_league(should_load_decks=True) still called on every PDBot API request with no caching
active_league(should_load_decks=True) still called on every /admin/matches/ page load
2020 partial fix moved matches display to livematchtable but commit message explicitly notes 'Sadly we still have to load all decks for the dropdowns for adding a match'
should_load_decks triggers full deck.load_decks() call loading complete deck objects including card lists
No caching mechanism found in league.py for the active_league result

triage.notes: A meaningful fix requires either (a) caching the active_league result with short TTL, (b) splitting the admin dropdown to load only deck metadata (not full card lists), or (c) creating a leaner PDBot endpoint. All three require architectural decisions about caching strategy or API surface.
